main_body: Central grey stone pillar (about 6px wide, rows 13-50) with spiral stair steps wrapping around it as wedge-shaped treads on the left and right
top_band: none: the central column column at x=16 is one uniform dark grey run (L=99) from row 14 to 49 under a 1-row light cap at row 13; the steps are seen as a side cut
evidence: The pillar has only a 1-row light cap (row 13) with no ellipse or plate wider than the shaft, which matches the red flat-band column cap. The stair treads are drawn as side-cut wedges with dark undersides and thin edge lines, like a spiral staircase seen as a side cut. They show no clear horizontal surface read from above. Several treads show a lighter face, but they read as fan-shaped profile pieces, not a top surface with a front face. It fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 9 distinct colours in total, against 66 and 185 for the references. Its median of 9 per tile is close to the stone reference's 11 but below the 18 of the other. Its shading ramp is a grey set of about 4 steps (a dark outline, mid, light, highlight), shallower than the 5-6 steps of the references. The outline is partly near-neutral, with 56% of dark edge pixels neutral against 7-9% in the references, so it leans toward the black sticker look. Texture is limited to step edge highlights and a few small details. There is no tile or stone texture such as the references have. It is lower than both references on structure and craft, so it fails.
